facts.text: Top hero panel: an adult person with short dark hair shaved at the sides and a small topknot stands centered on a wet rooftop or elevated walkway at night, wearing an all-black tactical outfit and combat boots, with arms at their sides and head turned toward the viewer's right.

The hero panel environment is dark and rainy, with visible rain streaks, reflective wet paving, metal railings on both sides, out-of-focus city lights, and a bright overhead light flare at the upper left.
Below the hero panel is a row of three full-body studio views on a plain dark background, labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK.
In the FRONT studio panel, the person faces the camera, standing upright with arms at their sides, wearing a black high-collared jacket, dark shirt, black cargo trousers, and black boots.
In the SIDE PROFILE studio panel, the person stands upright in profile facing the viewer's left, showing the jacket and trousers silhouette.
In the BACK studio panel, the person is seen from behind, standing upright in the black jacket, cargo trousers, and boots.
The FACE close-up shows the adult person with shaved-side dark hair, a small gathered topknot, a visible scar crossing one eyebrow, and a neutral expression.
The JACKET COLLAR detail shows black fabric with a high collar, zipper, and a strap with a buckle or fastener.
The HANDS detail shows two weathered hands with visible dirt or grime, fingers slightly curled.
The BOOTS detail shows black lace-up combat boots with worn, scuffed leather.
Visible labels in the sheet read HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
